Canvas & Aesthetics:
- Deep near-black background #101012, subtle crisp grid borders (border-[#222226]), warm-white typography (#f5f5f7), muted secondary text (#909096).
- Retro pixel aesthetic: orange, yellow, and red pixelated geometric shapes, pixel flag, pixel mascots/pixel cat accents, clean modular borders.

Header (49px high, fixed/sticky, border-b border-[#222226] bg-[#101012]/95 backdrop-blur):
- Left: Mistral pixel flame / stacked pixel mark and clean wordmark "MISTRAL AI".
- Center Nav links: Research, Sovereign AI, Cloud, Customers, Company.
- Right: "Get in touch" outline button, and "Log in" dropdown button.

Hero Section (~471px tall below header):
- Enormous centered two-line display headline (~90px font size, tracking-tight):
  "Mistral [inline pixel flag badge: iconic French orange/yellow/red gradient pixel blocks] is #1"
  "in Sovereign AI."
- Sub-pill / Announcement button centered beneath:
  Outlined rounded pill with orange glow / subtle border: "Introducing Mistral Large 4" with thumbnail icon and right arrow '->'.
- Pixel art decorative accents on left and right borders: orange/yellow stacked 8-bit stepped pixel blocks, red diamond accents, and small white pixel mascot / cat silhouettes.

Client Logo Rail:
- Thin bordered horizontal section with client logos in crisp monochrome white / low opacity:
  AXA, ASML, Cisco, Snowflake, CMA CGM, HSBC, Ericsson, TotalEnergies, ESA, BMW.

Floating Value Proposition / Floating Tags:
- Centered section headline: "No one else should hold the strings to your"
- Dynamic tag cloud / floating pill tags with subtle borders and dot indicators:
  Process knowledge, Intellectual property, Invention, Data, Core product development, Quality standards, Discovery, Proprietary AI, Private code base, Decision logic, Engineering practices, Design tradeoffs.

Core Architecture Section:
- Section header: "Mistral lets you decide how AI works in your organization."
- Four interactive anchor pillars / tabbed feature sections:
  1. Frontier open models: "We make the models. You keep them."
     - Body copy on sovereign weights, local hosting, community innovation. Link: "Discover Research ->"
  2. Proprietary intelligence: "We give you the tools. You tailor the models."
     - Domain fine-tuning, distillation, alignment with private enterprise knowledge. Link: "Discover Forge ->"
  3. AI operations: "We build the software. You put AI to work."
     - Sovereign enterprise workflows, deterministic tool calling, code generation. Links: "Discover Vibe ->", "Discover Studio ->"
  4. Flexible compute: "We host it. Or you do."
     - Multi-cloud sovereign endpoints, air-gapped on-premise clusters, carbon-neutral compute. Links: "Discover Inference ->", "Discover Compute ->"

Customer Proof & Evidence Section:
- Eyebrow: "See Sovereign AI at work."
- Title: "Learn about our customers"
- Industry tabs: [Energy and utilities] [Manufacturing] [Financial services] [Public sector]
- Verified customer stories & performance metrics:
  - TotalEnergies: Accelerating subsurface reservoir exploration and seismic interpretation with multimodal frontier models.
  - ASML: Engineering diagnostics identifying complex semiconductor sub-system errors 70% faster.
  - BNP Paribas: Accelerated cross-border KYC and compliance reviews from weeks to days.
  - European Patent Office: Prior art multilingual audio and document transcription accelerated from days to minutes.
- Verified quotes, metric badges, and sleek dark card containers with warm pixel highlights.

Deep Dive / Explore Cards ("Go deeper."):
- 3 featured illustrated cards:
  - "Research": Next-generation multimodal reasoning and open frontier weights.
  - "Sovereign AI": Complete deployment sovereignty, zero data retention, defense-grade isolation.
  - "Cloud": European sovereign API endpoints, high-throughput dedicated clusters.

Footer:
- Columns:
  - Build with us: Customers, Partners, Brand, Pricing
  - Dive deeper: Coding, Document intelligence, Speech, Applied AI services, All use cases
  - Company: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Privacy choices, Data processing agreement, Trust Center, Legal notice
- App download: "Get Mistral Vibe" badges.
- Bottom bar: "Mistral AI © 2026", Social links (GitHub, X, LinkedIn, Discord), theme toggle & language selector.

## Brand & Style
Mistral's current US/English homepage aesthetic combines high-density computational minimalism, architectural line grids, and sharp pixelated geometric art. Evoke extreme technical rigor, sovereign European engineering pride, and uncompromising clarity. Reject generic AI tropes like purple cosmic nebulas, glowing floating spheres, or cartoonish chatbot bubbles. Visual rhythm relies on deep near-black surfaces, hairline charcoal structural grids, warm ivory type, and precise geometric block mosaics shifting across red, rust, orange, and golden-yellow shades.

## Layout & Spacing
The layout implements a continuous hairline table/grid matrix where borders form structural compartments without floating margins. Desktop features a fixed 49px segmented navigation header across the viewport. Hero employs an asymmetrical split: 70% left column for the prominent headline with the pixel mosaic directly below, and 30% right column containing supporting prose and the Featured News feed. On mobile (390px), elements stack vertically: pixel mark with minimal actions, 40px two-line title, support copy, news card, orange mosaic, and a 2-column brand partner grid.

## Elevation & Depth
Depth is strictly planimetric and non-skeuomorphic, achieved entirely through hairline border delineations (`1px solid #232329`) and tonal surface contrast (`#101013` to `#16161b`). Discard diffuse soft drop shadows and volumetric blurs. Hover states shift internal cell fills subtly brighter rather than lifting off the page, preserving the architectural frame.

## Components
- **Top Navigation:** 49px tall partitioned bar; individual cells for Products, Industries, Research, Developers, Blog, Customers, Company, and a stark contrasting "Get in touch" cell.
- **Hero & News Grid:** Hairline-enclosed multi-cell structure housing the primary title, supporting copy, pixel art mosaic, and structured news ticker entries.
- **Pixel Mosaic:** Block-rendered geometric mosaic composed of pure geometric tiles transitioning through orange, rust, red, and yellow steps.
- **Solution Panels:** Six large technical solution cards detailing Mistral deployment, privacy tiers, and enterprise capabilities with high contrast borders and dense text hierarchy.
- **Buttons & Action Triggers:** Rectangular, sharp-cornered interactive blocks with high-contrast inverted fills or hairline outline states.

### Mistral AI Official Homepage Reconstruction (October 2026 Design Study)

We have reconstructed the official Mistral AI public homepage corresponding to the verified October 2026 design language and architectural standards:

1. **Brand System & Canvas Aesthetic**:
   - **Color Palette & Frame**: Deep `#101012` canvas with fine `#222226` grid borders, warm-white typography, and signature pixel accents in orange, yellow, and red.
   - **Header (49px)**: Fixed navigation bar displaying the official pixel wordmark, clean links (`Research`, `Sovereign AI`, `Cloud`, `Customers`, `Company`), and action triggers (`Get in touch`, `Log in`).
   - **Hero Section**: 471px-tall hero anchored by the display headline:
     > **Mistral [pixel flag] is #1 in Sovereign AI.**
     Accompanied by the announcement pill `"Introducing Mistral Large 4"`, stepped pixel block flourishes, red diamond markers, and the pixel mascot motifs.

2. **Verified Client Rails & Floating Value Proposition**:
   - **Enterprise Logo Strip**: Monochrome client rail including `AXA`, `ASML`, `Cisco`, `Snowflake`, `CMA CGM`, `HSBC`, `Ericsson`, `TotalEnergies`, `ESA`, and `BMW`.
   - **Autonomous Ownership Matrix**: Floating interactive tag cloud under *"No one else should hold the strings to your"*: `Process knowledge`, `Intellectual property`, `Invention`, `Data`, `Core product development`, `Quality standards`, `Discovery`, `Proprietary AI`, `Private code base`, `Decision logic`, `Engineering practices`, and `Design tradeoffs`.

3. **Core Four Pillars & Official Copy**:
   - **Frontier open models**: *"We make the models. You keep them."* (`Discover Research →`)
   - **Proprietary intelligence**: *"We give you the tools. You tailor the models."* (`Discover Forge →`)
   - **AI operations**: *"We build the software. You put AI to work."* (`Discover Vibe →`, `Discover Studio →`)
   - **Flexible compute**: *"We host it. Or you do."* (`Discover Inference →`, `Discover Compute →`)

4. **Audited Customer Stories & Proven Metrics**:
   - Interactive industry tabs (`Energy and utilities`, `Manufacturing`, `Financial services`, `Public sector`).
   - Exact documented claims:
     - **TotalEnergies**: Subsurface reservoir exploration and seismic interpretation with multimodal vision.
     - **ASML**: Sub-system error identification **70% Quicker**.
     - **BNP Paribas**: Cross-border KYC and compliance reviews reduced from **Weeks to Days**.
     - **European Patent Office**: Prior art multilingual document transcription with **99.4% Accuracy**.

5. **"Go Deeper" & 2026 Footer Architecture**:
   - Illustrated product cards for `Research`, `Sovereign AI`, and `Cloud`.
   - Dedicated client launcher for `Get Mistral Vibe for macOS & Linux`.
   - 3-column structured footer: `Build with us`, `Dive deeper`, and `Company` with legal/privacy notices and live operational status indicators. All obsolete news and legacy bands were removed.
